seed='''        return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());'''
for name,src in variants.items():
 (p/f'{name}.hpp').write_text(src)
 fixed='#include <cstdlib>\n'+src.replace(seed,'        return std::strtoull(std::getenv("TREAP_SEED"), nullptr, 0);')
 (p/f'{name}_main.cpp').write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+fixed+'\n'+(r/'Verify/current/drivers/implicit_treap_affine_main.cpp').read_text())
 subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-march=native','-DEVAL','-DONLINE_JUDGE','-I'+str(r),str(p/f'{name}_main.cpp'),'-o',str(p/name)],check=True)
print('built',flush=True)
rows=[];rng=random.Random(842); names=['max_02','max_00','max_01','max_03','max_04','max_random_00','extreme_insertion_01','wrong_avl_killer_00'];expected=json.loads(next(Path('/tmp/treap_next').glob('library-checker-problems-*')).joinpath('data_structure/dynamic_sequence_range_affine_range_sum/hash.json').read_text())
for rep in range(6):

 for name in names:
  vs=list(variants);rng.shuffle(vs)
  for v in vs:
   t=time.perf_counter()
   with (Path('/tmp/treap_next/inputs')/f'{name}.in').open('rb')as f:x=subprocess.run([str(p/v)],stdin=f,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,check=True)
   dt=time.perf_counter()-t;h=hashlib.sha256(x.stdout).hexdigest();assert h==expected[name+'.out'],(v,name,h)
   rows.append(dict(rep=rep,name=name,variant=v,seconds=dt,hash=h))
 (p/'screen-raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print('rep',rep,flush=True)
summary=[]
for name in names:
 row={'name':name}
 for v in variants:

 summary.append(row)
